== Course of events ==

Alice's sojourn through Wonderland takes her once more into the Duchess's company. Having encountered her in a most agreeable humor and walked with her amongst the curious croquet ground, Alice comes to discover an unexpected preoccupation consuming the Duchess entirely: she becomes obsessed with finding moral lessons in everything.

What began pleasantly proves increasingly taxing. The Duchess's relentless quest to extract moral instruction and philosophical meaning from all that surrounds them becomes a test of Alice's patience. Her young companion finds herself enduring this singular fixation, wherein every trifle and circumstance becomes fodder for the Duchess's fevered search for moral lessons.

Leaving this encounter behind, Alice's journey in Wonderland progresses onward, eventually drawing her toward the melancholy Mock Turtle and the Gryphon, where new revelations about this curious realm await.
